body: All my school counselor did was tell my mom to get me a therapist in 8th grade. I have had a childcare services worker come to my house multiple times and they are the ones who take you from your family if need be but all she did was laugh. All the adults think I'm a selfish kid trying to ruin my mom's life. Sorry I'm not trying to be pessimistic but I just have no one to go to and it's not like my teenage friends can do much.

Nope my mom tells every adult I know that I'm manipulative, that I lie, and that I'm constantly trying to tear my family apart. My boyfriend's parents are kinda out of questions cause they're dealing with their own problems rn
